name: Diff Viewer
description: Line-based diff view with added/removed/context coloring, a +/- gutter, and old/new line numbers.

anatomy.description: Dual old/new columns; a number appears only on lines that exist in that version.
+ / - / space sign column, tinted per line type and hidden from assistive tech.
Monospace code line with a row tint per type and a visually hidden Added/Removed/Unchanged prefix.

dos: Pass hunks when the diff already comes from git or a server instead of re-diffing strings.
Give the label the file or change name, like 'config.js changes', so the group is usefully named.
Leave lineNumbers on for anything longer than a handful of lines.
donts: Don't use it as an editor; it is a read-only review surface.
Don't drop all context lines; unchanged lines are what frame the change.
Don't diff very large files inline; summarize and link out past a few hundred lines.

examples.title: From two strings
examples.description: Computes the line diff itself from oldValue and newValue, including dual line-number gutters.

examples.title: Pre-computed hunks
examples.description: Accepts explicit add/remove/context lines, useful when the diff comes from git or a server.

guidance.useWhen: A config change, file edit, or generated output needs a compact before/after review inline in the page.
guidance.avoidWhen: Users must edit or comment on individual lines; use a full code review surface instead.
guidance.behavior: Given oldValue/newValue it computes a line-level LCS diff; given hunks it renders them verbatim. Added lines are tinted primary, removed lines error, and screen readers hear an Added/Removed/Unchanged prefix per line.
guidance.responsive: Scrolls horizontally within its bordered pane so long lines never break the layout.

notes: Each line carries a visually hidden Added, Removed, or Unchanged prefix so the change type is not conveyed by color alone.
The gutter signs and line numbers are aria-hidden to keep the screen-reader output linear.
